dishes.name: Limburgse vlaai
dishes.desc: Round fruit tart on a yeast dough base, with rice or cherry filling. A tradition across Limburg on both sides of the Dutch border.

dishes.name: Hasseltse speculaas
dishes.desc: Local spiced biscuit baked in Hasselt for centuries, strongly tied to the city's bakers.

dishes.name: Haspengouw fruit syrup
dishes.desc: Thick apple or pear syrup cooked in Haspengouw orchards, spread on bread. A farm product of the Limburg fruit belt.

dishes.name: Haspengouw fruit tart
dishes.desc: Tart with Haspengouw cherries, plums or apples, from the orchard region of Limburg and Sint-Truiden.
